_comment: Competitions the model ignores, mostly women's football: ESPN often gives women's teams the same names as men's ("Chelsea", "United States"), which would mix their ratings. Patterns are case-insensitive substrings of the ESPN league/competition name; a leading '=' means the whole name. The backfill also drops leagues whose slug matches excludeLeagueSlugPattern (ESPN marks women's leagues with '.w'). predict applies excludeCompetitions to fixtures; keep kDefaultExclusions in src/main.cpp in sync.
